policy: Every proposal is accounted for, including inactive entries. No compatibility quota or cap. Programs, size variants, embedding API cases and upstream files remain separate counts. Corpus verification does not assert support by every engine or publish performance measurements.

officialV8.policy: Unmodified upstream V8 runner, real published build configuration, upstream default variants/status filters. No corpus quota. Zero tests or an incomplete schedule is a runner error. Status-selected skips are never counted as passes. This is the full enabled mjsunit/wasm suite for this build, not all V8 test suites.

proposals.name: Acquire-Release Atomics

compatibility.verification: see retained exact-artifact report

limitations: The encoder and runtime pin V8 15.2.20, which uses memarg bit 5 for ordering. The current proposal Overview uses bit 4; that newer wire format is not qualified here. Single-agent RMW checks do not prove inter-thread memory ordering.
